what_this_does_not_say: That a collision is worth preventing. It says what one costs to prevent. The work measured is a read and a parse; a real agent also sends the file to a model, which costs seconds and money this script cannot measure without a network - so these are floors, and the break-evens are ceilings.
where_the_time_goes: Opening the store, not coordinating. The compare-and-swap is well under a millisecond; every MCP tool opens the store, does its work and closes it, which is where the rest of the call goes.
